prompt: We're building firmware for our warehouse robot arm's motor controller board (STM32F103RCT6, 72MHz). I need a single C source file called `motor_controller.c` that pulls together three things: (1) a PWM output on PB5 to drive the motor at the standard servo frequency with proper idle positioning, (2) an interrupt-driven UART receiver that parses incoming ASCII speed commands in the format `SPEED:75` and passes them to the motor control logic, and (3) proper task isolation so the UART handler and the motor controller run independently and communicate through a message queue. The docs folder has our requirements spec for reference. Please make sure the PWM timing, the speed-to-register mapping, and the inter-task communication all match our hardware platform's constraints.
